## Audit Complete

**new/dart-gen-bs/gen_app_panuy_ent1.dart:92, 99, 178, 188** · Computed field קרוב reads user input instead of constant value · **P1 wrong result** · Replace `(_v[14] ?? '')` with `gen_app_panuy_ent1_c32`

### Defect

The spec requires: `קרוב = מרחק בריבוע < 100 ? קרוב : רחוק`

This is a **computed text field** that should display the constant string "קרוב" when distance < 100, else "רחוק".

The generated code incorrectly uses `(_v[14] ?? '')` (the user input slot) instead of `gen_app_panuy_ent1_c32` (the constant 'קרוב'). This means the field will try to display whatever the user types, rather than the computed value.

**Lines affected**: 92 (_card), 99 (_csv), 178 (_live widget), 188 (DataGrid)

### Verification

✅ No state-leakage to other apps — only panuy files + sechirut renumbering (expected)  
✅ No orphans or spec file regressions (police passes all structural checks)  
⚠️ Gates pass because they check syntax, not semantic correctness  
❌ **Task incomplete** — logic error in generated computation

Full report written to `_audit-regression.md`.
